construct: sup(absolute, translate(50%,-50%)) > bdi > span > span — a count digit THREE levels deep in an absolutely positioned overlay, the deepest span carrying NO identity class (antd's rc-scroll-number `current` is transient and dropped by classAllow; the fixture spells the same absence with a bare span — the frontier eval refuses any non-neutral class in a case)
why: When union alignment collapses a deep unit span into positional naming (part-<path>), the label must still carry its text. A badge whose digit vanishes is still a red dot — recognisable, and silently wrong (P2 exam S7).

canvas.note: the digit is the badge's only content; the overlay is the absolute-cluster door (GEOM_ADMIT)
